test_resolve_judge_config_cli_over_env: test that _resolve_judge_config prefers CLI arguments over environment variable fallback values
test_resolve_judge_config_env_fallback: test that _resolve_judge_config falls back to GAIA2_JUDGE_* env vars when CLI flags are None
test_resolve_judge_config_missing_error: test that _resolve_judge_config raises click.UsageError when both model and provider are missing
test_resolve_agent_config_requires_provi: test that _resolve_agent_config raises UsageError for agent images when provider and model are None
test_save_run_config_persists_judge_sett: test that _save_run_config writes judge_model, judge_provider, and judge_base_url to run_config.json
